properties.site-address: Former Primary School, Claver Close, Swainby
properties.notes: Former Primary School, Swainby, (no relevant planning history). 8 to 10 affordable dwellings in total, 2 or 3 bedroomed dwellings as an exceptions site (Core policy K of the LDF) with road frontages on to Claver Close and an area of open space in the southern area of the site to maintain the open character of the site.
